verdict.rationale: With LOCALAI_AUTH=true, LocalAI documents per-user API keys plus admin/user roles, so an agent could get its own non-admin credential with coarse privilege separation. Nothing shows keys can be scoped below the role level, for example to specific models, endpoints or tools, or issued specifically to an agent. Missing for 10: fine-grained key scopes (per-model/endpoint/tool permissions), agent-specific credential issuance, key expiry/revocation controls, detailed docs on API key management, independent or hands-on corroboration.
